newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: BHP says Foster's stake under review.
newsitem.headline: BHP says Foster's stake under review.

text.p: The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd (BHP) said on Friday its 37 percent stake in Foster's Brewing Group was under constant review, as were all BHP assets.

BHP's stake in Foster's is worth about A$1.8 billion at the current market price. "It's an asset of BHP which is being looked at, as all of the assets of BHP are being looked at," spokesman Terry Bowe told Reuters.
If the company deems a sale appropriate, the stake will be sold, he added. This has been the consistent position of BHP managing director John Prescott, Bowe said.
BHP has not indicated a timeframe for a final decision on the Foster's investment, but newspapers have speculated that BHP wants to make a final decision by its May 30 balance date.
BHP and Foster's both declined on Friday to say if the issue was discussed at their most recent board meetings, held over the past two weeks.
BHP's investment in Foster's has been delivering improving returns over the past two years. But the share price has largely underperfomed the market's All Ordinaries leading indicator.
A Foster's spokeswoman declined on Friday to comment.
Speculation about changes to Foster's share register resurfaced on Friday with a newspaper report that 14-percent shareholder Asahi Brewing had indicated it was a seller.
The report in The Australian newspaper quoted an unnamed Asahi spokesman as declining to make any comment on the rumour.
